frozen_vocabularies_from_contract.note: listed separately because the schema has more than one field named verdict; the claim this map makes is about EvaluationCaseResult specifically

taxonomy_answer_for_action_3: The four vocabularies are separate and all four are already frozen, so the card's list is met without widening any enum: the case verdict enum is PASS/FAIL/ERROR/ABSTAIN/MISSING (no INVALID), INVALID is a value of EvaluationReport.integrity_status alongside COMPLETE and INCOMPLETE, INCONCLUSIVE is a MetricResult status and a Goal outcome, and REJECT/WATCH are Goal outcomes. Putting INVALID in the verdict enum would contradict the published contract, so this card characterises the distinction in tests instead of editing the schema it does not own.

ops/ci/experiments.py contains no 'smoke' text at all: it is a nine-line shim that goes to research.main('test.experiments') when RESEARCHOS_TASK_ID=W08 and to evaluation.main('experiments') otherwise
first_draft_audit.false_absence_in_draft: the draft claimed the 12 frozen smoke cases were 'named nowhere'; they are a checked-in file, spec/v2.0/examples/evaluation_smoke_cases.json, with 12 cases PF-01..PF-12 plus 6 additional_faults, already read by adapters/evaluation
first_draft_audit.one_tooling_false_negative: a check for the Goal definition first reported it missing because the shell expanded $defs to an empty string; the def is present. A tool artifact is not evidence of absence, so the enums here are parsed from the JSON document instead of grepped.

note_on_scope: The map is not a claim that the card is done. It says which of the four actions already have a witness on disk, at what line, and names the three gaps this card must close.
